title: Naturality and finite coefficient scalar compatibility of the prescribed rational Koszul braiding
statement:
Let $\ell$ be prime, $\Omega$ an algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, and $W$ any scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible in every residue field. For every finite coefficient subfield $E\subset\Omega$, use the raw rational constructible category $C_E=D^b_c(W,E)$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] (objects are integral derived-complete bounded constructible objects and Hom modules are localized, without Karoubi completion), its tensor $T_E$, and its normalized tensor scalar comparisons [def-sf-finite-rational-derived-operations]. For $E\subset L$, write $F_{EL}:C_E\to C_L$ for the prescribed rational scalar extension [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi] and $\lambda_{EL;A,B}:F_{EL}T_E(A,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_L(F_{EL}A,F_{EL}B)$ for this specific comparison. Let $\sigma^E_{A,B}:T_E(A,B)\xrightarrow{\sim}T_E(B,A)$ be the prescribed rational Koszul braiding [def-sf-rational-common-tensor-symmetries]: the localization of the coherent-reduction-normalized integral Koszul braiding [def-pod-integral-tensor-constraints], using the specified tensor-object identifications. These isomorphisms form a natural isomorphism $T_E\cong T_E\circ\mathrm{swap}$. Explicitly, for arbitrary localized arrows $a:A\to A'$ and $b:B\to B'$,
$$\sigma^E_{A',B'}\circ T_E(a,b)=T_E(b,a)\circ\sigma^E_{A,B}.$$
For every $E\subset L$ and every $A,B\in C_E$, including identity and ramified extensions, the prescribed scalar comparison satisfies
$$\lambda_{EL;B,A}\circ F_{EL}(\sigma^E_{A,B})=\sigma^L_{F_{EL}A,F_{EL}B}\circ\lambda_{EL;A,B}.$$
No finite-field structure on $W$, perfectness of the inputs, or torsion-freeness of Hom modules is assumed.
